notes:
What's new

- EPUB books read like books now: chapters flow as real text with headings, paragraphs, lists and tables instead of a file listing.
- Page Down / Page Up move between chapters, and the header shows where you are (CHAPTER 1 / 3).
- WinPreview remembers your chapter for a book, so reopening it picks up where you stopped.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.18 - EPUB reader (1D, part 1). container.xml/OPF spine parsing, XHTML chapters sanitised into the document block model, chapter markers with PageUp/PageDown navigation from measured offsets, and reading progress persisted per book. .epub no longer opens as an archive. 19 new checks, office suite now 77.
